items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Them guys used to come around from Melbrook, Timothy Leery and Alpred and stuff, and me and here being in Mingus we'd go up there and they huge melonous estate and they'd give us acid and stuff from Switzerland

ctx.x: Oh yeah, but something else people don't know, there were a lot of writers and stuff that would hangout cause I like to read, but this is really deep. Them guys used to come around from Melbrook, Timothy Leery and Alpred and stuff, and me and here being in Mingus we'd go up there and they huge melonous estate and they'd give us acid and stuff from Switzerland...
